It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. python - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from lxml import etree as E
from pathlib import Path
from pptx import Presentation
import hashlib, os
src='/tmp/baseball_audio_draft.pptx'
dst=Path('/app/Mady_and_Mia_Baseball.pptx')
ns={'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main','p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'}
with ZipFile(src) as z:
 data={n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
slide=E.fromstring(data['ppt/slides/slide1.xml'])
for el in slide.findall('.//a:videoFile', ns):
 el.tag='{'+ns['a']+'}audioFile'
for el in slide.findall('.//p:video', ns):
 el.tag='{'+ns['p']+'}audio'
for el in slide.findall('.//p:audio/p:cMediaNode/p:cTn/p:stCondLst/p:cond', ns):
 el.set('delay','0')
data['ppt/slides/slide1.xml']=E.tostring(slide,xml_declaration=True,encoding='UTF-8',standalone=True)
r='ppt/slides/_rels/slide1.xml.rels'
rels=E.fromstring(data[r])
for rel in rels:
 if rel.get('Type','').endswith('/video'):
  rel.set('Type',rel.get('Type').rsplit('/',1)[0]+'/audio')
data[r]=E.tostring(rels,xml_declaration=True,encoding='UTF-8',standalone=True)
with ZipFile(str(dst)+'.tmp','w',ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
 for name,blob in data.items(): z.writestr(name,blob)
with ZipFile(str(dst)+'.tmp') as z:
 assert z.testzip() is None
 mp3=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.mp3')]
 assert len(mp3)==1
 assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(mp3[0])).digest()==hashlib.sha256(Path('/app/Baseball.mp3').read_bytes()).digest()
assert len(Presentation(str(dst)+'.tmp').slides)==8
os.replace(str(dst)+'.tmp',dst)
print('Saved:',dst,'Bytes:',dst.stat().st_size)
print('Verified: 8 slides, matching embedded MP3, automatic first-slide audio playback.')
PY
